sentences.text: Maddula Madhava Pappundala Madhava ... vs The State Of

Andhra Pradesh, on 17 March, 2020
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy

Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.1550 Of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short "Cr.P.C") seeking quash of the F.I.R. in Crime No.50 of 2020 of Kolluru Police Station, Guntur District.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners.
3.
The petitioners are the accused in Crime No.50 of 2020 of Kolluru Police Station, Guntur District.

Prosecution in the above crime was launched against them for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 420, 270, 272, 273 and 188 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 56,
57(1) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

4. The issue is squarely covered by three judgments of this Court whereunder criminal proceedings launched against various persons in the said petitions of similar nature are quashed by this Court as not maintainable under law.

This Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27-8-2018; in Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18-12-2019; and in Crl.P.No.5103 of 2019 and batch, dated 05-4-2020, held that the prosecution under the aforesaid Sections of law in the facts and circumstances of the case is not maintainable under law.
Therefore, the petitioners herein, who are also similarly placed, who are facing the prosecution for the same nature of offences, are also entitled to the similar relief.

5. Hence, in view of the aforesaid judgments of this Court, the petition is allowed and the criminal prosecution launched against the petitioners in Crime No.50 of 2020 of Kolluru Police Station,
Guntur District, is hereby quashed.

Pending applications, if any, shall stand closed.
____________________________________________ JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY Date : 17-03-2020 Note: Issue CC by 18-03-2020 (B/o) ARR THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH
ROY CRIMINAL PETITION No.1550 Maddula Madhava Pappundala Madhava ... vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
